title: iOS .NET export crashes with signal 11 on 4.8-beta1
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.8.beta1.mono.official - 4d10419ca
- Not reproducible in: 4.8.dev7.mono.official

### System information

macOS 26.1 (25B78), Apple M1, 8 threads, arm64 - 4.8.beta1.mono.official [4d10419ca] (official .NET build), Xcode 26.1.1, .NET SDK 10.0.400

### Issue description

When I export a C# project for iOS with 4.8-beta1 I encounter a crash:


The same work in the 4.8.dev7.mono.official release.

Let me know if I can help to bisect the issue.


### Steps to reproduce

This happens with a very minimal hello-world type C# project. The MRP has one Node2D and one c# script with ETC2/ASTC turned on an an iOS export preset.

You need Xcode, the .NET 10 SDK, and the 4.8-beta1 .NET editor with its export templates installed. I used Godot_v4.8-beta1_mono_macos.arm64.zip and Godot_v4.8-beta1_mono_export_templates.tpz

```bash
develop-simulator:mrp-test shipthis$ unzip -q ~/mrp-ios-csharp-export.zip && cd mrp-ios-csharp-export
develop-simulator:mrp-ios-csharp-export shipthis$ GODOT=~/g48/godot/godot-4.8.0.mono-beta1-sc/Godot_mono.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot
develop-simulator:mrp-ios-csharp-export shipthis$ "$GODOT" --version
4.8.beta1.mono.official.4d10419ca
develop-simulator:mrp-ios-csharp-export shipthis$ "$GODOT" --headless --path . --build-solutions --quit
```
